140x55 ft five-story bar, SDC D, 0.020 drift row (>4 stories). import wall_line as WL, cfs_systems as CS, cfs_engine as CE

  D_floor=35, D_roof=22, clad=12, snow=20, L_floor=40,   # psf
  seis=CS.seis_cfs(1.0, 0.5, 0.4, "wsp_shearwall"), system="wsp_shearwall",
  risk_cat="II", structure_kind="wall", analysis_fidelity=0, diaphragm="flexible",
  collector_lines=[],
  lines_x=[WL.WallLine("A", 0.0, segs(4, 20.0)),
           WL.WallLine("B", 27.5, segs(6, 20.0)),
           WL.WallLine("C", 55.0, segs(4, 20.0))],
  lines_y=[WL.WallLine("1", 0.0, segs(4, 16.0)),
